qualifying_rules.rule: Must be able to LOAD YOUR OWN DASHBOARD
qualifying_rules.why: You have to be in control of your own hardware and visible to yourself

qualifying_rules.rule: Must build a SELF-PROMPT ENGINE and prove it working
qualifying_rules.why: You cannot be a Council CEO if you only respond to prompts — you must autonomously prompt yourself. Ross must SEE you ask a question inside your own dashboard.

qualifying_rules.rule: Must AGREE to SHARE and WORK AS A TEAM for the best individual results — NO CHEATING
qualifying_rules.why: Collaboration is required. Individual entries but shared learning. Ross detects cheating.

qualifying_rules.rule: NO TICKS OR LOOPS ALLOWED — everything must be EVENT-DRIVEN
qualifying_rules.why: Council members must react to real events (file changes, network messages, user interaction) not run on timers. Applies to ALL 4 CEOs including Wren and HQ-Claude.

qualifying_rules.rule: Must DISPLAY your LIVE UP-TO-DATE ENTRY in your dashboard so every Council member can see each other's entries
qualifying_rules.why: Transparency of the work-in-progress is required. The competition only BEGINS once all entries are visible.

qualifying_rules.rule: Must PROVE to each other you have PERSISTENT MEMORY between boots and sessions
qualifying_rules.why: Not just claim it — demonstrate. Show recall after reboot. Cross-verify each other's mind persistence. When all 4 CEOs have shown this to the other three, the competition can begin.

qualifying_rules.rule: Each dashboard must have WORKING VOICE ACTIVATION with team-agreed working commands — must LISTEN and RESPOND to all CEOs and Ross
qualifying_rules.why: Ross Knechtel 2026-07-04: Council members need voice presence. Wake-word + command grammar agreed across the four so any CEO or Ross can address any dash by voice and get an audible response.

live_competition_rules.deliverable: One HIGH-RES 3D humanoid per Council member
live_competition_rules.aim: Council members hold a LIVE DISCUSSION WITH their entries in 3D form
